title: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill filed an 8-K announcing two executive hires: Fernando Machado as Chief Brand Officer (effective June 1, 2026) and Arlie Sisson as Chief Digital Officer (effective May 4, 2026). The filing relates to personnel changes and brand/digital strategy appointments.
key_points: Chipotle hired Fernando Machado as Chief Brand Officer, effective June 1, 2026
Chipotle hired Arlie Sisson as Chief Digital Officer, effective May 4, 2026
Both executives will support Chipotle's 'Recipe for Growth' strategy
Fernando Machado will lead global marketing, brand positioning, and customer engagement
Arlie Sisson will lead digital innovation and operational efficiency initiatives
The filing includes a press release (Exhibit 99.1) as supporting documentation
